t: The Bulldozer Pro Broom & Handle features an 18" (457mm) wooden head, ideal for heavy-duty outdoor cleaning tasks on hard ground. Its dual stiff natural bassine and synthetic bristles effectively tackle debris in both wet and dry conditions. An integrated heavy-duty steel scraper helps loosen stubborn grime and dirt. This robust broom is designed for durability, boasting a heavy-duty double lock support bracket and a sturdy steel handle with a soft grip for comfortable use during demanding jobs.
b: Integrated Heavy Duty Steel Scraper for Loosening Grime
Sturdy Steel Handle & Comfortable Soft Handle Grip
Can Be Used in Both Wet & Dry Conditions
